integrity: The projective-line interval follows from the source's exact quotient V direct-sum V, surjective polynomial action, Schur centralizer calculation, and the correspondence theorem. Finite-field enumeration is a supplementary regression check and is not used as proof of the arbitrary-field statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem describes the counterexamples obtained from the splitting-field construction in arXiv:2610.04317v1, not every possible nonmaximal contraction. It does not address centrally infinite division rings. Full text of the closest 2025 Chapman--Paran article was unavailable for inspection; its abstract and its Proposition 2.3 as reproduced in later primary literature were checked.
title: Projective-line geometry of Amitsur–Small contraction failures
